title: Time Rift
description: A shimmering tear hangs in the air where past and present bleed together. Through the distortion you glimpse landscapes that haven't existed for centuries, overlaid with visions of places yet to be. The edges of the rift crackle with temporal energy that makes your skin prickle.

choices.label: Reach through the rift
choices.description: Plunge your hand into the temporal distortion and pull back whatever you can grasp.

outcomes.text: Your fingers close around something solid. You pull back a vial of congealed temporal residue, still warm.
You snatch a handful of displaced coins and a crystalline fragment that doesn't belong to any era you recognize.
The rift snaps shut on your arm. Time itself lurches through your body — your vision fractures into a thousand overlapping moments.

choices.label: Study the temporal patterns
choices.description: Carefully observe the rift's oscillations to collect the echo essence it sheds.

outcomes.text: Patient observation reveals the rift's rhythm. You catch falling drops of echo essence as they crystallize in midair.
The patterns are mesmerizing. You gather essence, but the overlapping timelines leave you dizzy and disoriented.
The rift pulses with a steady rhythm. You collect a modest amount of essence before the shimmer fades.

choices.label: Back away carefully
choices.description: Temporal anomalies are unpredictable. Discretion is the wiser choice.

outcomes.text: You retreat from the crackling distortion. The rift shudders once, then folds silently in on itself.
